title: Weak Hessian bounds along every geodesic in RCD spaces
displayName: Weak Hessian bounds along every geodesic in RCD spaces

statements.hypotheses: Complete separable full-support RCD(K,N), unreduced CD, finite on bounded sets, K real, 1<N<infinity; F bounded globally Lipschitz; G bounded continuous; inequality for every compactly supported original g in Test and every nonnegative compactly supported Lipschitz h.
conclusions: For every constant-speed minimizing geodesic of length ell, (F∘sigma)'' <= ell² G∘sigma in D'(0,1).
For G=c, F∘sigma-c ell²t²/2 is concave; no global L²(m) assumption on F and no finite total mass required.
statements.checked: Full statement, (1.1)–(1.4), and proof pp.9–10 compared.

statements.hypotheses: Same space; V bounded globally Lipschitz.
conclusions: Same Sobolev space and weak gradients; D(Delta_V)=D(Delta); drift formula; equivalent graph norms.
Every xi in weighted generator domain with xi and Delta_V xi bounded has globally Lipschitz representative.
statements.checked: Statement and complete proof read; original heat resolvent estimate compared with AGS15 Corollary 2.3.

conclusions: For all lambda>0, unchanged metric d and m_lambda=exp(lambda F)m satisfy CD(K-lambda G,infinity).
statements.checked: Statement and proof pp.7–8 including exact identity, graph closure, constant and variable equivalence read.

proofPassages.scope: Compact core via original heat regularization and cutoffs; local Hessian and nonnegative Lipschitz multiplier approximations; capacity measure argument.
Both generator-domain inclusions, graph-norm equivalence, resolvent contraction in E and uniqueness.
(4.2)–(4.4) identity with negative Hessian; (4.6) graph closure before (4.7); metric prerequisites for AGS and BHS.
Nonbranching to strict-subsegment uniqueness; shrinking endpoint balls; lambda dominates endpoint entropies; compactness; Green formula and distributional conclusion.
